title: In what year did half of the world's people first use the internet?
subtitle: Guess the year half of humanity first got online, then see the hundred-person world: who is still offline, and where.
form: ask on a scale (click the year)
notes: Crossing year per OWID series: 49.4 % in 2018, 53.9 % in 2019. Two hundred-person grids for rich (94) and poorest (23) countries. Scale tick labels and population legends stay small. The frames tool does not show the viewer s pin at the reveal (the player keeps it).
